snippet.title: Ascend to New Commercial Heights | Stick it to the Stickman Leaves Early Access on September 23
snippet.description:
Physics-based stickman brawler Stick it to the Stickman brings corporate satire and sick moves to PC when it leaves Early Access on September 23.

Punch, kick, slice, dice, burn, blast, staple-gun, fireball, jackhammer, and chainsaw your way up the corporate ladder solo or with a 'friend' in a truly hostile work environment. And remember: every red stickman you defeat is one dead red stickman closer to a promotion!
